diagram_previews.alt: Left: oblique sketch of a regular tetrahedron ABCD with front edge AB, apex D and back vertex C; the hidden edge AC is grey dashed. M is the midpoint of AB; a red segment MD lies on face ABD and a red dashed segment MC runs inside. Right: triangle MCD in true shape, with MC and MD labelled root 3, CD labelled 2 and the angle theta at M marked.
